deadline.value: Fall applications are reviewed on a rolling basis; those received before January 1 get priority.
deadline.quote: Completed applications for Fall admission will be reviewed on a rolling basis, but applications received before January 1 will be given priority.

gre_general.value: The department says satisfactory GRE scores may be submitted but are not required.
gre_general.quote: Satisfactory scores on the general Graduate Record Examination (GRE) may be presented, but are not required

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants interested in a particular faculty member should contact them directly.
supervisor.quote: If you are interested in working with a particular faculty member, it is best to contact them directly.

funding.value: Research assistantships come from individual faculty grants, and only a limited number of teaching assistantships are available.
funding.quote: A limited number of teaching assistantships are also available.

also.quote: Research assistantships are offered by individual faculty from their research grants and contracts.

entry_route.value: An accredited bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent education is the admission requirement.
entry_route.quote: An accredited bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent education
